machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

implementation.arithmetic: The four linears are forced through the original scalar FP32-operand kernel. The normal >=64-row dispatcher would choose FP16 operands and change conditioning values.
implementation.binding_strategy: The 80-row modulation and final-scale tables are computed once; each step copies its two rows into the existing small buffers, leaving all block and final-norm bindings unchanged.

cache_off.wall_interpretation: The 75 ms increase is within observed run-to-run variation; no cache-off wall improvement is claimed from this single pair.

rejected_followup.candidate: Use 256 threads per threadgroup for every generic one-dimensional dispatch instead of the pipeline SIMD width of 32.
rejected_followup.decision: Rejected and reverted. A blanket launch-size change helps wide elementwise kernels but harms serial row reductions and small conditioning dispatches; any future change must select threadgroup size per kernel.
